title: Rust: canonical permitted masks and sparse sets
description:
Implement bounded CCP2 permitted-set validation and operations alongside the plan primitives exported by rust/lichen-core/src/lib.rs. Represent masks as ceil(channel_count/8) bytes with index i at bit 7-(i mod 8), require zero unused bits and retain sparse global indices during membership, intersection and ascending iteration. Counts and indices must be validated before use. Do not apply legacy u32/u64 clipping or renumber the set after intersection.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: This extracts only mask/set mechanics from rust.01. Reuse b7z9.23's admission/intersection structure where compatible, preserving legacy behavior in rust/lichen-core/src/tdma_beacon.rs and rf_health.rs until explicit versioned integration. The registry is rust.01.registry; rust.01 validates their combined boundary. No new bitset dependency, framework or wire allocation is required. Preserve identity/radio ownership, baseline SCHC/security, best-effort custody and deferred portability; no audited OSCORE/EDHOC edits or hardware access.
acceptance_criteria: Consume independent vectors.03 byte strings and set expectations through production mask APIs in rust/lichen-core/tests. Check counts 0/1/8/32/64/128/255/256, wrong lengths, nonzero padding, all-zero and CH0-only sets, upper indices and sparse {0,64,127} encoded as 80000000000000008000000000000001. Verify intersection and iteration retain original global indices and bounded no_std storage. Run targeted core tests, cargo check --no-default-features -p lichen-core, fmt and scoped clippy. Round trips and implementation-generated expected masks are not independent oracles.
